definition: On the #750 signature and rivals. oneWay: ground with one ranking, target first. settled ground: favouring reports the outcome. acting: two necessary sources with opposite rankings, and acts true exactly with their outcomes. varying: contingent reasons that differ between outcomes, with fixed rankings. overlap: the rival outcome true together with the target at 0. favourless: no favouring. Also the #755 ground with no rival-outcome fact, and #750's necessitarian under the target-first ranking.
note: Analyst-built models. A model shows that a formal bundle is satisfiable, not that it is metaphysically possible. No model has a predicate for persons. See docs/notes/explanatory-symmetry-742.md.
